title: Walking More Won't Fix The 43% Activity Gender Gap
hook: A 43% gender gap explains nearly half of activity inequality.
closing: Activity health depends on who gets opportunities to move, not only total steps.
question: Who gets fewer walking opportunities?

segments.say: Hong Kong averages 6,880 steps daily, nearly double Indonesia. Where you live shapes how much you move.
Where activity is most unequal, the obesity risk index reaches 297. Uneven movement has a measurable cost.
The gender step gap explains 43 percent of activity inequality. Nearly half the problem sits inside one divide.
